svg.title: Product organization
svg.desc: Product organization. 11 components. Connections: Chief Product Officer to Design; Chief Product Officer to Engineering; Chief Product Officer to Product management; Design to User research; Design to Brand and UI; Engineering to Platform; Engineering to Web app; Engineering to Mobile apps; Product management to Growth; Product management to Payments.

text.tspan: Three levels, from the chief product officer to the teams, as an org chart
